feed.title: Google Cloud: Certificate Manager
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Certificate Manager

entry.content:
You can now attach tags to Certificate Manager resources during creation. This feature is available in Preview.

For more information, see Create and manage tags for Certificate Manager resources.
entry.summary: You can now attach tags to Certificate Manager resources when you create them. This feature is available in Preview. Learn how to create and manage tags for your Certificate Manager resources.
entry.title: Feature: Tag Certificate Manager resources

entry.content:
Certificate Manager (2nd gen) is available in Preview. Certificate Manager (2nd gen) offers a unified control plane to observe, manage, and automate certificates across your organization.

For more information, see Certificate Manager (2nd gen) overview.
entry.summary: Certificate Manager (2nd gen) is now available in preview, providing a unified control plane to manage and automate certificates across your organization. This new version simplifies certificate operations and enhances visibility.
entry.title: Feature: Certificate Manager (2nd gen) in preview
